title: Wavetable Oscillator
idiom: a zoetrope, a drum of frames read around and around, as a two-ink woodcut with the wave running out of the drum as one repeating ribbon; icon as a bold linocut ring holding a single cycle of a wave
hero_prompt: Woodcut print on cream paper in two flat inks, black and brick red, visible wood grain and ink texture, flat and graphic, hand-made, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no gradients: at the left of a wide frame, a zoetrope, an open-topped round drum on a short turned wooden stand, seen a little from above so the inside wall of the drum shows. A row of narrow upright slots runs around the upper rim of the drum. Around the inside wall runs one continuous paper band, and along the band one bold smooth wave line is drawn, a single rise and a single fall, repeated in each panel of the band. Two or three bold curved strokes beside the drum show that it is spinning. From the right side of the drum the same wave line runs out as one long unbroken red ribbon across the whole rest of the frame to the right edge, the same rise and fall repeated evenly six or seven times. Plain cream paper background, nothing else in the scene, no people, no hands, no other objects.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a solid brick red ground, no shading or gradients: one thick, perfectly smooth black ring, centred, and inside it a single thick black wave line that crosses the ring from the left side to the right side, rising once in a round hump in the left half and dipping once in a round hollow in the right half, joined to the ring at both ends. Nothing else. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
